blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Sparse attention is a primary approach to reducing the latency of diffusion transformers in long-sequence generation tasks, such as video and high-resolution 3D asset generation. However, existing methods can degrade generation quality and fidelity at high sparsity levels. Through controlled oracle comparisons, we trace this degradation to three sources: constraints imposed by token grouping, inaccurate interaction selection, and the attention contributions lost when tokens are discarded. Guided by this analysis, we propose Meta-Cached Sparse Attention (MC-Sparse), a training-free framework that selects individual key-value (KV) tokens while organizing similar queries into tile-aligned groups for efficient GPU execution. MC-Sparse caches metadata comprising query groups, KV indices selected using exact attention probabilities, and residuals between dense and sparse attention outputs, and reuses them across subsequent denoising steps. Across video and 3D generation models, MC-Sparse achieves higher fidelity to dense-attention outputs and larger denoising speedups than existing sparse-attention baselines, without visible quality degradation. Relative to dense attention, it delivers a 1.80 × 1.80\times denoising speedup on Minimax-H3-Base and a 2.32 × 2.32\times speedup on 3D asset generation, both with negligible quality loss.
blocks.zh: Sparse关注是减少扩散变压器在视频和高分辨率3D资产生成等长序列生成任务中的延迟性的首要方法. 然而,现有方法可以降低产生质量和高度的忠诚度。 通过有控制的甲骨文比较,我们追踪这种退化到三个来源:由符号分组施加的限制,不准确的交互选择,以及当符号被丢弃时失去的注意力贡献. 在这项分析的指导下,我们提议Meta-Cached Sparse Region(MC-Sparse),这是一个无培训框架,它选择单个的密钥值(KV)符号,同时组织类似的查询到瓷砖相通组中,以便高效地执行GPU. MC-Sparse缓存元数据包括查询组,使用精确的注意概率选择的KV指数,以及密集的注意输出和稀有的注意输出之间的剩余值,并在之后的去诺步骤中再使用. 在整个视频和3D生成模型中,MC-Sparse在不出现明显质量退化的情况下,比现有的稀疏基线更忠实于密集的输出和更大的去诺加速。 相对于密集的注意,它在Minimax-H3-Base上交付了1.80×1.80\times去诺加速,在3D资产生成上交付了2.32×2.32\tims去快,两者质量损失都微不足道.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Diffusion transformers ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) have become a dominant backbone for high-fidelity video and 3D asset generation ( Wan et al., 2025 ; MiniMax, 2026 ; Lai et al., 2025b ; Lai et al., 2025a ) . However, their growing sequence lengths make attention a major inference bottleneck: its quadratic cost scales rapidly with video duration and output resolution, since it must process spatiotemporal video tokens and geometric 3D tokens. Sparse attention offers a natural remedy, as attention often concentrates on a small subset of token interactions. Yet aggressive sparsity frequently degrades generation quality, leaving a persistent gap between the efficiency of sparse attention and the fidelity of dense attention.
blocks.zh: 分流变压器(Peebles and Xie, 2023)已成为高真视频和3D资产生成的主导支柱(Wan等,2025;MiniMax, 2026;Lai等,2025b;Lai等,2025a). 然而,其不断增长的序列长度使得注意力成为了主要的推想瓶颈:它的四相成本尺度会随着视频持续时间和输出分辨率而迅速出现,因为它必须处理spatiental视频符和几何3D符. sparse关注提供了一种自然的补救方法,因为关注往往集中在一小部分象征性的相互作用上. 然而,猛烈的痉挛往往会降低发电质量,在注意力稀少和注意力密集之间留下了长期的差距。

blocks.en: Most existing methods impose sparsity at block granularity ( Xi et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025c ) . Block-sparse attention (BSA) selects entire KV blocks for each group of queries, which maps well onto efficient GPU tiles. In practice, block importance is typically estimated from pooled query and key representations ( Li et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2026a ) . This design entangles two sources of error: the approximate scores used to pick blocks, and the coarse block layout that restricts which interactions can be picked at all. As a result, it is hard to tell how much of the quality gap stems from the selector, how much from the block structure, and how much persists even when both are improved.

blocks.en: We examine these questions through controlled oracle comparisons at matched attention densities (i.e., the same sparsity level). Each oracle maximizes the retained attention mass using exact dense-attention probabilities, but differs in selection granularity: the block oracle selects oracle KV blocks for each query group; the token oracle selects or oracle individual KV tokens for each query group; and the per-query oracle further lets every query choose its own KV tokens. Comparing mean-pooled BSA with these oracles, and the oracles with one another, isolates three sources of the quality gap (Fig. 2 ): structural binding error , which arises because KV tokens are bound together in blocks and different queries in the same group share a single selection; selection error , which arises from approximate scoring (e.g. mean pooling); and discarded tail error , which arises because omitted tokens still carry nonzero attention mass. These findings motivate three design principles: finer-grained selection, accurate attention scoring, and compensation for discarded contributions.
blocks.zh: 我们通过在相应的注意力密度(即同为平缓度)下进行有控制的甲骨文比较来审查这些问题。 每个甲骨文利用精确的密集意向概率来使所保留的注意力质量最大化,但在选择颗粒性上却有所不同:块甲骨文为每个查询组选择甲骨文为KV块;符号甲骨文为每个查询组选择或甲骨文为KV个个个个个个个个;而每克甲骨文进一步让每个查询选择自己的KV个个个. 将平均集合的BSA与这些甲骨文,以及甲骨文相互比较,孤立出质量差距的三个出处(图2): 结构绑定错误,因为KV令牌被捆绑成块,同一组的不同查询共享一个选择; 选择错误,来自近似分数(例如:指集合); 被丢弃的尾部错误,因为省略的令牌仍然带有非零注意力质量. 这些结论激励了三项设计原则:精细的挑选、准确的注意分和对被丢弃的贡献的补偿。

blocks.en: Realizing these principles efficiently is challenging. First, exact token-level selection requires computing attention scores, which is expensive, and gathering individual KV tokens causes irregular memory access. Second, queries must still be grouped into sufficiently large tiles for efficient GPU execution. Unconstrained clustering can group similar queries to reduce structural binding, but it yields variable-size groups that must be padded to fill the kernel’s computation tiles, wasting computation ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) . Third, token-level selection removes the block structure that would otherwise provide a natural way to summarize discarded regions for compensation.
blocks.zh: 有效实现这些原则具有挑战性。 首先,精确的符号级选择需要计算出注意分数,这很昂贵,而收集单个KV符号会导致内存访问不规则. 第二,仍然必须把询问分成足够大的牌,以便高效地执行GPU。 不受限制的集群可以将相似的查询分组来减少结构绑定,但它产生可变大小的组,这些组必须被加入来填补内核的计算平板,浪费计算(周等,2026). 第三,象征性级别的选择可以去除块状结构,否则会提供一个自然的方法来总结被丢弃的区域,以获得补偿。

blocks.en:
Temporal redundancy across denoising steps offers a way to amortize exact selection and to support compensation. We find that reusing exact selections from earlier steps can outperform recomputing mean-pooled selections at every step, and that the dense–sparse output residual changes little between nearby steps. Building on these observations, we propose Meta-Cached Sparse Attention (MC-Sparse) , a training-free framework that combines token-level KV selection, tile-aligned query grouping, and cross-step reuse. At anchor steps, MC-Sparse groups similar queries into equal-size tiles, selects KV tokens according to their exact attention mass aggregated over each query group, and records the dense–sparse output residual. Subsequent steps reuse the query groups, selected indices, and cached residuals, while computing attention with the current queries, keys, and values. This amortizes the cost of grouping and exact selection, and the cached residuals compensate for the discarded tail across steps. To make this efficient in practice, we develop fast Principal
Direction Divisive Partitioning(PDDP) ( Boley, 1998 ) for grouping, a two-pass exact selector for selection, and a token-sparse attention kernel for execution.

各个取消提名步骤之间的时间冗余提供了一种办法,可以摊还准确的选择和支持补偿。 我们发现,重用早期步骤的精确选择可以超越每一步的重算平均集合选择,而密集的-平分输出残留在相邻步骤之间变化不大。 基于这些观察,我们提议Meta-Cached Sparse Region(MC-Sparse),一个将符号级KV选择,瓦片相通的查询分组,并跨步再利用相结合的无培训框架. 在锚地步骤上,MC-Sparse将相似的查询分组为等大小的平板块,根据每个查询组的精确注意力量总和来选择KV令牌,并记录密度-spare输出余量. 随后的步骤再利用查询组,所选索引,和缓存的剩余部分,同时用当前查询,密钥和值计算注意力. 这对分组和精确选择的成本进行了分期摊还,被缓存的残骸会补偿被丢弃的尾巴跨步骤. 为了提高实际效率,我们发展快速的校长

blocks.en: Across the evaluated video models, MC-Sparse achieves higher fidelity to dense-attention outputs and larger denoising speedups than the compared sparse-attention baselines, while preserving visual quality. On Minimax-H3-Base, at 15% attention density, it reaches a 1.80 × 1.80\times DiT denoising speedup over dense attention with higher fidelity than competing sparse methods. On HY3D-Internal, at the same density, it achieves a 2.32 × 2.32\times denoising speedup with negligible quality degradation.
blocks.zh: 在经过评估的视频模型中,MC-Sparse在保持视觉质量的同时,比相对稀少的基线更忠实于密集的注意力输出和更大的去诺加速。 在Minimax-H3-Base上,在15%的注意力密度下,它会达到1.80×1.80\times DiT以比相竞争的稀有方法更高的忠诚度去除密集注意力的加速. 在HY3D-Internal上,在相同的密度下,能实现2.32×2.32\times去诺加速,质量可忽略不计.

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We use controlled oracle comparisons to disentangle three sources of quality degradation in sparse attention: structural binding error, selection error, and discarded tail error, and quantify how each affects attention fidelity at matched attention densities. • We propose MC-Sparse, a training-free framework that combines token-level KV selection and tile-aligned query grouping with cross-step reuse of exact selections and output residuals, together with efficient GPU implementations. • We demonstrate the effectiveness and generality of MC-Sparse on multiple diffusion transformer models, spanning both video and 3D asset generation.

blocks.en: We first examine where vanilla BSA loses fidelity relative to dense attention. An oracle selector retains the entries with the largest dense-attention probability mass under a fixed attention density. We consider three oracles (Fig. 2 ): the block oracle selects KV blocks for each query block; the token oracle (shared Q block) selects individual KV tokens but shares one selection within each query block; and the per-query oracle selects KV tokens independently for each query. At matched densities, comparing vanilla BSA with these oracles and with dense attention isolates three sources of the gap: structural binding error, selection error, and discarded tail error.
blocks.zh: 我们首先检查 香草BSA 失去忠诚 相对于密集关注。 甲骨文选择器在固定的注意力密度下保留了密度-注意概率最大的条目. 我们考虑三个甲骨文(图2):块甲骨文为每个查询块选择了KV区块;符号甲骨文(共享Q区块)选择了单个KV区号,但在每个查询块内共享一个选择;而每克甲骨文为每个查询独立选择了KV区号. 在相匹配的密度下,将香草 BSA 与这些甲骨文和密集的注意力相比较,分离出差距的三个来源:结构绑定出错,选择出错,被丢弃的尾部出错.

blocks.en: Because exact selection and query grouping are costly, MC-Sparse exploits the stability of attention across denoising steps: it performs them only at anchor steps and reuses the resulting query groups, KV indices, and dense–sparse output residual at subsequent reuse steps . In the following subsections, we analyze each error in turn and introduce a corresponding design.
blocks.zh: 由于精确的选取和查询分组成本高昂,MC-Sparse利用了调取步骤的注意稳定性:它只在锚定步骤中进行,并在随后的再利用步骤中重复使用所产生的查询组、KV指数和密集-sparse输出残留。 在以下分节中,我们依次分析每个出错,并引入相应的设计.

blocks.en: 4.1 Mitigating Structural Binding Error
blocks.zh: 4.1 减轻结构性约束错误

blocks.en: Structural binding error arises from two constraints of block-sparse attention. KV binding forces a block-sparse selector to retain irrelevant neighbors of important tokens, while query binding forces queries with different attention patterns to share one selection (Fig. 3 (a)). Moving from the block oracle to the token oracle with shared query blocks removes KV binding, and moving further to the per-query oracle removes query binding. The accuracy gains at each step (Fig. 2 ) show that both constraints cause losses. Table 4 further confirms this at matched realized densities: finer KV granularity and grouping more similar queries both improve fidelity.
blocks.zh: 结构绑定误差是由块状分层注意的两个限制因素而来. KV 绑定会迫使块分隔选择器保留重要符号的无关相邻,同时会查询绑定会迫使有不同关注模式的查询共享一个选择(图3(a)). 从块甲骨文移动到有共享查询块的符号甲骨文删除了KV绑定,再进一步移动到每克甲骨文删除了查询绑定. 每个步骤的准确性提高(图2)表明,这两个限制因素都造成损失。 表4在相应的实际密度下进一步证实了这一点:更细的KV颗粒度和比较相近的询问组合都提高了忠诚度。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We presented MC-Sparse, a training-free framework for accelerating diffusion
transformers with token-level sparse attention. Our oracle comparisons show
that the dense-to-sparse gap extends beyond selection accuracy to include
structural binding and discarded tail contributions. Guided by this analysis,
MC-Sparse combines token-level KV selection and tile-aligned query grouping
with temporal reuse and residual compensation, balancing approximation
quality with execution efficiency. Experiments on video and 3D asset
generation demonstrate improved fidelity to dense-attention outputs and
reduced denoising latency compared with the evaluated sparse-attention
baselines.

We fuse group-wise aggregation into the second pass and apply top- K K to the
aggregated attention mass, avoiding materialization of the dense attention
matrix.

next gather with the current computation.
